title: Explainable machine learning to compare the overall survival status between patients receiving mastectomy and breast conserving surgeries.
summary: Nature full text reports explainable gradient-boosting survival models comparing mastectomy and breast-conserving surgery in 2,509 METABRIC patients, with SHAP-derived predictors and held-out test metrics. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
ai_technology: Gradient boosting models and SHAP explain predictors of overall survival by surgery group.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Test accuracy and SHAP predictors differ between mastectomy and BCS groups; this is a retrospective association, not causal treatment guidance.
evidence.unknown: Nature full text reports explainable gradient-boosting survival models comparing mastectomy and breast-conserving surgery in 2,509 METABRIC patients, with SHAP-derived predictors and held-out test metrics. Held-out test metrics and feature-importance analysis support the bounded retrospective diagnostic/prognostic claim.
evidence.ai_role: Gradient boosting models and SHAP explain predictors of overall survival by surgery group.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
